terms.definition: The rate at which electric charge flows past a point in a circuit, measured in amperes.
The work done per unit charge in moving charge between two points, measured in volts.
How strongly a conductor opposes the flow of current through it, measured in ohms.

sourceNote: Written for this project as the glossary of the Ohm's law story (ADR 0085); its statements are claims of the knowledge base (mock content, ADR 0080).
